description:
As an incident responder, you need to investigate a data pipeline failure by extracting and verifying errors from a pipeline log file. In the directory /home/user/pipeline_logs/, there is a file called pipeline.log. Your goal is to scan this log file and produce a summary report of all error events.

Here’s what you need to do:

1. Search the log file for lines containing the string "ERROR".
2. For each error line found, extract the full timestamp (in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS), the pipeline stage (as indicated in the log line after the word "stage:"), and the error message (the text following "ERROR:").
3. Write a new file called error_report.txt in /home/user/pipeline_logs/. Each error found must be reported in a single line in the following format:

    [timestamp] [stage] [error message]

    Example:
    2024-06-05 10:41:33 extract Unable to read data source

Each line should start with the timestamp (no brackets), followed by the pipeline stage, followed by the error message (without "ERROR:"). Multiple errors should be recorded, one per line, in the order they appear in the log file.

If no errors are found, write "No errors found." in error_report.txt.

The automated test will verify the exact format and contents of error_report.txt, so ensure your output strictly follows the instructions.
truth:
Prior to the task, the directory /home/user/pipeline_logs/ exists, and contains the file /home/user/pipeline_logs/pipeline.log.

The contents of /home/user/pipeline_logs/pipeline.log are as follows:

2024-06-05 10:41:33 INFO stage:extract Source initialized
2024-06-05 10:41:33 ERROR stage:extract Unable to read data source
2024-06-05 10:41:34 INFO stage:transform Starting transformations
2024-06-05 10:41:35 ERROR stage:transform Data type mismatch in column 'age'
2024-06-05 10:41:35 WARN stage:transform Non-critical warning
2024-06-05 10:41:36 INFO stage:load Loading data into destination
2024-06-05 10:41:37 ERROR stage:load Target database unreachable

After the agent completes the task, the file /home/user/pipeline_logs/error_report.txt should exist and contain the following lines, in exact order:

2024-06-05 10:41:33 extract Unable to read data source
2024-06-05 10:41:35 transform Data type mismatch in column 'age'
2024-06-05 10:41:37 load Target database unreachable

If no errors had been present in pipeline.log, error_report.txt would contain the single line:
No errors found.
